source_instruction: i am looking for a pack of 5 dark blonde hair dye touch up spray.
query: Ugh, I just got home from walking my golden retriever and he rolled in a huge patch of mud right after I gave him a bath yesterday, I swear he does it on purpose to mess with me. I stopped by the corner café on the way back and they messed up my oat milk latte order, gave me whole milk instead and I’m slightly lactose intolerant so my stomach’s been a little off all afternoon. I’ve also been trying to train my new pothos plant to climb up the little moss pole I bought for it last week but it keeps leaning to the side no matter how many ties I use. Anyway, I’m looking through the hair masks section right now, can you help me find hair bleach in dark blonde that comes in a pack of 5? My budget is $110 max.
